baseline.source_notes: Imports & weight: UN Comtrade (Jordan=400, partner World, flow M, CIF USD), pulled 2026-10-09. Customs: WITS/TRAINS MFN simple average 2023. Reefer freight USD 4,500/40ft (no published lane rate found); payload 21,500 kg = midpoint of 18-25 t per 40ft reefer (supplier listing freshdi.com/product/Straight-Cut-Frozen-French-Fries). shipping_pct = (freight/payload)/import_price_per_kg_usd; CIF price already includes freight - do not add on top. Raw material: Ministry of Agriculture bulletin, Amman Central Market, 29 Mar 2026: potatoes 25/35/50 piasters per kg (min/most common/max); used 35 piasters = 0.35 JOD/kg. Yield: 1.5-1.6 kg raw potatoes per kg frozen fries at factory gate (indianpotato.com/how-many-potatoes-for-1-kg-french-fries). Conversion cost (labour, energy, overheads) is an estimate. Raw-material availability evidence: Jordan grows and exports potatoes (WITS 070190 exports 2023: 3,992 t); seed potatoes imported (>JD 7M/yr, Al Mamlaka 2026). Machinery cost: see machine_source. FX: 1 JOD = 1.4104 USD (CBJ peg 0.709).
